# Data thinning

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(scales)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(ConR)

options(scipen = 999)
```

```{r thinning}
# Define raster at modeling resolution
r <- rast(
  xmin = -120, xmax = -30,
  ymin = -35,  ymax = 35,
  resolution = 0.0833  # ~10 km
)

your_df <- readRDS("../data/db_modelling_strict.rds")

# Thin: one record per species per cell
set.seed(123)
thinned <- your_df %>%
  mutate(cell = cellFromXY(r, cbind(decimalLongitude, decimalLatitude))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cell)) %>%
  group_by(scientificName, cell) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-cell)

# Check record loss
original_n <- nrow(your_df)
thinned_n  <- nrow(thinned)

cat(
  "Records removed:", original_n - thinned_n,
  "(", round((1 - thinned_n / original_n) * 100, 1), "%)\n"
)
```

# Record summary after thinning

```{r record-summary}
species_summary <- thinned %>%
  count(scientificName, family, genus, name = "n_thinned") %>%
  left_join(
    your_df %>%
      count(scientificName, name = "n_original"),
    by = "scientificName"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    record_class = case_when(
      n_thinned < 5 ~ "<5 records",
      n_thinned < 10 ~ "5-9 records",
      TRUE ~ ">=10 records"
    ),
    record_class = factor(record_class, levels = c("<5 records", "5-9 records", ">=10 records"))
  )

record_class_summary <- species_summary %>%
  count(record_class, name = "n_species") %>%
  mutate(percent_species = round(100 * n_species / sum(n_species), 2))

record_class_summary %>%
  kable(caption = "Species by thinned record-count class") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r record-histogram, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
ggplot(species_summary, aes(x = n_thinned)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, boundary = 0, fill = "grey70", colour = "grey30") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(5, 10), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Number of thinned records per species",
    breaks = pretty_breaks()
  ) +
  ylab("Number of species") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

```{r record-class-bar, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
ggplot(record_class_summary, aes(x = record_class, y = n_species)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey70", colour = "grey30") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n_species, " (", percent_species, "%)")), vjust = -0.3) +
  xlab(NULL) +
  ylab("Number of species") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

# EOO

```{r eoo-computing, eval=FALSE}
XY <- thinned %>%
  select(decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude, scientificName)

# Batch EOO for all species at once
eoo <- EOO.computing(
  XY,
  exclude.area = TRUE,
  export_shp = FALSE,
  method.range = "convex.hull",
  method.less.than3 = "arbitrary", # gives a value to species with two unique occurrences
  file.name = "EOO.results",
  parallel = TRUE,
  NbeCores = 4,
  show_progress = TRUE
)

saveRDS(eoo, "../data/eoo_results.rds")
write.csv(eoo, "../data/eoo_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r load-or-use-eoo}
eoo <- readRDS("../data/eoo_results.rds")
```

# EOO joined with family and record counts

```{r eoo-family-join}
records_per_species <- thinned %>%
  count(scientificName, name = "n_records")

species_taxonomy <- thinned %>%
  distinct(scientificName, genus, family)

eoo_family_all <- eoo %>%
  rename(
    scientificName = tax,
    EOO = eoo
  ) %>%
  left_join(species_taxonomy, by = "scientificName") %>%
  left_join(records_per_species, by = "scientificName")

# Main analysis filter requested: EOO > 5 and valid family.
# This removes zero / near-zero arbitrary EOOs and species without family names.
eoo_family <- eoo_family_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(family), !is.na(EOO), EOO > 5)
```

# Density plot: total + Big 5 families

```{r eoo-density-big5, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
# Big 5 families by number of species after EOO > 5 filtering
big5_families <- eoo_family %>%
  distinct(scientificName, family, EOO) %>%
  count(family, name = "n_species", sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  pull(family)

plot_df <- eoo_family %>%
  distinct(scientificName, family, EOO) %>%
  mutate(panel = "All families") %>%
  bind_rows(
    eoo_family %>%
      distinct(scientificName, family, EOO) %>%
      filter(family %in% big5_families) %>%
      mutate(panel = family)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    panel = factor(panel, levels = c("All families", big5_families)),
    log10_EOO = log10(EOO)
  )

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = log10_EOO)) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 0.9, fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.45, na.rm = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = expression(log[10]("EOO, km"^2)),
    labels = label_number()
  ) +
  ylab("Density") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

# Family-level EOO summary

```{r family-summary}
family_summary <- eoo_family %>%
  group_by(family) %>%
  summarise(
    n_genus   = n_distinct(genus, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_species = n_distinct(scientificName),
    n_records = sum(n_records, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_eoo     = sum(!is.na(EOO) & EOO > 5),
    mean_eoo  = mean(EOO, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_eoo = median(EOO, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_eoo    = sd(EOO, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_eoo   = min(EOO, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_eoo   = max(EOO, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_log10_eoo   = mean(log10(EOO), na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log10_eoo = median(log10(EOO), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    range_class = case_when(
      median_eoo < 50000 ~ "endemic-rich",
      median_eoo < 500000 ~ "intermediate",
      TRUE ~ "widespread-dominated"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_species))

family_summary %>%
  kable(caption = "Family-level EOO summary after EOO > 5 filtering", digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "600px")
```

# Country occupancy and IUCN EOO threshold

```{r country-eoo-flags}
# Number of countries per species using thinned records.
# Uses countryCode when available, otherwise country.
countries_per_species <- thinned %>%
  mutate(country_id = coalesce(countryCode, country)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(country_id), country_id != "") %>%
  group_by(scientificName) %>%
  summarise(
    n_countries = n_distinct(country_id),
    countries = paste(sort(unique(country_id)), collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

species_flags <- eoo_family_all %>%
  left_join(countries_per_species, by = "scientificName") %>%
  mutate(
    n_countries = replace_na(n_countries, 0L),
    le_2_countries = n_countries <= 2,
    eoo_lt_50000 = !is.na(EOO) & EOO > 5 & EOO < 50000,
    both_criteria = le_2_countries & eoo_lt_50000
  )

criteria_summary <- tibble(
  criterion = c(
    "Species present in <=2 countries",
    "Species with EOO < 50,000 km2 and EOO > 5",
    "Species fulfilling both criteria"
  ),
  n_species = c(
    species_flags %>% filter(le_2_countries) %>% summarise(n = n_distinct(scientificName)) %>% pull(n),
    species_flags %>% filter(eoo_lt_50000) %>% summarise(n = n_distinct(scientificName)) %>% pull(n),
    species_flags %>% filter(both_criteria) %>% summarise(n = n_distinct(scientificName)) %>% pull(n)
  )
)

criteria_summary %>%
  kable(caption = "Species meeting country occupancy and EOO range-restriction criteria") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

# Family summary for species fulfilling both criteria

```{r both-criteria-family-summary}
both_species <- species_flags %>%
  filter(both_criteria, !is.na(family)) %>%
  distinct(scientificName, family, genus, n_records, EOO, n_countries, countries)

both_family_summary <- both_species %>%
  group_by(family) %>%
  summarise(
    n_genus = n_distinct(genus, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_species = n_distinct(scientificName),
    n_records = sum(n_records, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_records_per_species = min(n_records, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_records_per_species = max(n_records, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_records_per_species = mean(n_records, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_records_per_species = median(n_records, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_species))

both_family_summary %>%
  kable(
    caption = "Family summary for species present in <=2 countries and with EOO < 50,000 km2",
    digits = 2
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "500px")
```

# table of species fulfilling both criteria

```{r both-criteria-species-table}
both_species %>%
  arrange(family, genus, scientificName) %>%
  select(family, genus, scientificName, n_records, n_countries, countries, EOO) %>%
  kable(
    caption = "Species fulfilling both criteria",
    digits = 2
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "600px")
```
